verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas's own Editor docs say changes appear instantly through live editing, including modifying scripts while the application runs, which matches a near-instant preview after a script change. The claim comes from a single marketing-level passage, with no detail on how script hot-swapping works. missing for 10: documentation of the script hot-reload mechanics (e.g. state preservation and swap behavior), hot reload for the local Vite/engine workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration of loop speed.

support.subject: As a game developer, the edit-run loop is fast — hot reload or near-instant preview after a script change

citations.quote: Make a change, see it instantly. With live editing, you can tweak materials, adjust positions, and even modify scripts while your application runs.
